title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-maya-2026-03-10
content:
Daily triage scratchpad - Maya Chen (quick notes, repro steps, follow-ups)

Summary:
- Customer report: dashboard panels showing 500 errors on /api/metrics endpoint intermittently since ~2026-03-08 22:30 UTC. Affects orgs: AcmeCorp (high priority), BetaApps (medium).
- Symptoms: spike in 5xx in console dashboard (route: /api/metrics), panels fail to load, sometimes entire dashboard times out. Errors appear correlated with a specific model route (redwood/gptx-32k) being used heavily.
- Current hypothesis: upstream model routing fallback + cache eviction causing long tail latency and ultimately gateway 502/504 surfacing as 5xx in dashboard panels.

What I saw (quick):
- 2026-03-09 22:38 UTC: spike on per-route latency graph.
- 2026-03-09 22:41 UTC: dashboard panel A (token-cost breakdown) returns 502 consistently for ~6m.
- 2026-03-09 22:50 UTC: manual curl to /api/metrics from staging NAT -> 200, but from prod edge returns 504.
- Slack thread: #console-ops -> link: slack://channel?team=redwood&id=console-ops (see messages by @Noah Park)

Repro steps (manual):
1) Hit /api/metrics with sample payload (see below) from prod edge (us-west)
2) Observe 504 after ~30s when concurrency > 120 req/s to redwood/gptx-32k
3) Curl from internal staging gateway returns 200 -> suggests edge routing / timeout config difference

Sample payload (sanitized):
- route: /api/metrics
- params: {start: "2026-03-09T22:30:00Z", end: "2026-03-09T22:45:00Z", org: "AcmeCorp"}

Quick checks to run (priority order):
- [ ] Confirm edge timeout config vs internal gateway: nginx/proxy read_timeout and gateway SLOs (ask infra)
- [ ] Check model routing logs for redwood/gptx-32k at 2026-03-09 22:30-23:00 UTC (Jordan Lee?)
- [ ] Confirm cache eviction events around that time (KV cache misses) -> may tie to cold KV causing long runtime init
- [ ] Pull full trace for a failed panel request (trace id present in dashboard panel error)
- [ ] Verify if autoscaler launched new dedicated instances (dedicated pool) and if they registered successfully

Notes / observations:
- No obvious increase in error rates on serving-runtime metrics (4xx/5xx normal), but there is a long-tail latency bump on kv-cache-hit-ratio drop.
- One customer (AcmeCorp) did a large backfill run at same time -> extreme seq-length + batch sizes plausible cause.
- Console UI uses combined calls (embeddings + metrics) -> failure in one subcall surfaces as whole panel error. Need to decouple or surface partial responses.

Tentative action plan (short-term):
- Maya Chen: collect request IDs and attach to JIRA-OBS-412 (today EOD)
- Jordan Lee: pull model router logs + routing policy changes (check for fallback to heavier instance)
- Noah Park: check edge timeout values and proxy logs, increase read timeout temporarily if safe
- Taylor Chen: check autoscaler events and capacity registration (if dedicated pool missed registration, we may see timeouts)

Longer term follow-ups (to capture in backlog):
- Dashboard: show partial panel results and more granular error reasons (500 vs 502 vs 504)
- Observability: add synthetic load for long-seq workloads to detect KV cold-starts
- Runtime: consider faster cold-start path for quantized models + warm-up on heavy backfills

Client communication (draft):
- For AcmeCorp: short note acknowledging we've seen the spikes, asking for their backfill window + offering a short call to correlate logs. Draft: "Thanks — we saw elevated 5xx on your dashboard yesterday evening around 22:30 UTC. We're collecting request IDs and traces; can you share the time window for the backfill and approximate batch sizes? We may recommend throttling the backfill or contacting us for a coordinated warm-up to avoid cold-start latency."

Open questions / unknowns:
- Is the edge/proxy config different for certain customer routes? (Noah Park to confirm)
- Did any recent deploy touch fallback policy for gptx-32k? (Jordan Lee)
- Are there any rate-limit spikes that correlate with the client backfill? (check per-org rate limits)

Quick commands / pointers:
- k get pods -n serving | grep gptx-32k  # check pod restarts
- gcloud logging read "resource.type=global AND jsonPayload.route="/api/metrics"" --limit 100 --freshness=1d
- Trace: trace.redwood/prod/<trace-id> (attach after we collect)

Follow-ups (assignments):
- Maya Chen: attach logs + request IDs to JIRA-OBS-412, ping AcmeCorp contact (L. Ramirez) by EOD (PST)
- Jordan Lee: deliver model-router log dump and note any fallback events (tomorrow morning)
- Noah Park: confirm proxy timeouts + propose safe bump (if needed)
- Taylor Chen: confirm autoscaler registration events + dedicated pool health (ASG/instance group)

Misc TODOs (personal):
- [ ] Clean up findings and add to Confluence page (CONFLUENCE-obs-dashboard)
- [ ] Draft follow-up postmortem if this recurs
- [ ] Add synthetic test to CI that simulates a single org heavy backfill

Random notes to self:
- Might be worth surfacing KV hit-rate per-org on the panel (would make root-cause faster)
- Check GH-PR-7890 for partial results work — see if change set touches panel error handling
- If we increase edge timeout, add a rollback plan and alerting to avoid masking true failures

End of scratchpad.
summary: Triage notes for intermittent dashboard 5xx errors related to /api/metrics; probable interaction between model routing, KV cache cold starts, and edge timeouts. Tasks assigned to Maya Chen, Jordan Lee, Noah Park, Taylor Chen.
